nodes.description: Immutable upgrade-control flags (_BASE, _CODEHASH, _UPGRADABLE) of the Upgradable contract.
Immutable human-readable version tag of the implementation (_VERSION).
Immutable _ESTIMATED_REPORT_RESULT_GAS used to derive the minimum reward for a data request.
WitnetBoardState.owner address, controls administration and ACLs.
WitnetBoardState.numQueries counter, incremented on every posted request.
WitnetBoardACLs.isReporter_ mapping controlling which addresses may report results.
EIP-1967 implementation slot of WitnetProxy holding the active implementation address.
reportResult(uint256,bytes32,bytes): reporter-only entry point that uses block.timestamp as solving time.
reportResult(uint256,uint256,bytes32,bytes): reporter-only entry point taking an explicit timestamp.
_reportResult: stores the response metadata and transfers the escrowed reward to the reporter.
deleteQuery: returns and deletes a reported query, restricted to its requester.
postRequest: payable entry point escrowing a reward and registering a new query.
upgradeReward: adds msg.value to an existing request reward and may raise the gas price.
estimateReward: computes the minimum required reward from a gas price.
setReporters: owner-only addition of addresses to the reporters ACL.
unsetReporters: owner-only removal of addresses from the reporters ACL.
transferOwnership: owner-only ownership transfer.
initialize: delegatecall initializer setting the owner and reporters of the proxy storage context.
destruct: owner-only selfdestruct of the implementation.
isUpgradableFrom: tells whether a caller is allowed to upgrade the proxy.
WitnetProxy.fallback: delegatecalls arbitrary data to the current implementation.
WitnetProxy.upgradeTo: validates upgradability and delegatecalls initialize on the new implementation.
WitnetProxy.implementation: reads the current implementation address from the EIP-1967 slot.
_getGasPrice: returns tx.gasprice as the transaction price.
_getMsgValue: returns msg.value as the payment value.
_safeTransferTo: performs the native ETH payout to the reporter.
_state: returns the storage pointer to the WitnetBoardState struct at a fixed slot.
_acls: returns the storage pointer to the WitnetBoardACLs struct at a fixed slot.
getNextQueryId: returns numQueries + 1.
readRequestBytecode: re-fetches and hash-checks the bytecode of a posted request.
readResponseResult: decodes the stored CBOR bytes into a Witnet.Result.
_proxySlot: returns the EIP-1967 implementation storage slot.
msg.sender: used for ACL checks, ownership checks, requester identification and reward payout.
block.timestamp: used as the solving timestamp of a reported result.
Native ETH transfer via payable(_to).transfer(_amount) to the reporter.
selfdestruct(payable(msg.sender)) destroying the implementation.
Assembly delegatecall in WitnetProxy.fallback forwarding arbitrary calldata.
Delegatecalls performed by upgradeTo on the old and new implementations.
Arithmetic: _gasPrice * _ESTIMATED_REPORT_RESULT_GAS, overflow risk.
Arithmetic: ++ _state().numQueries, overflow risk.
Arithmetic: _request.reward + _getMsgValue(), overflow risk.
External call to bytecode() on a user-supplied IWitnetRequest contract.
Read of tx.gasprice to derive the minimum reward.
Parameter _queryId identifying a posted query.
Parameter _timestamp of the solving tally transaction in Witnet.
Parameter _drTxHash of the solving tally transaction in Witnet.
Parameter _cborBytes holding the Witnet-provided result.
Parameter _addr of the IWitnetRequest contract providing the data request bytecode.
Parameter _reporters / _exReporters array to add or remove from the ACL.
Parameter _newImplementation address of the new implementation contract.
Parameter _initData raw data used to initialize the new implementation.
Parameter _gasPrice for which rewards must be estimated.
Local _value holding msg.value inside postRequest.
Local minResultReward used in the reward threshold check of postRequest.
Local storage pointer _request to the posted request record.
Local _newReward computed in upgradeReward.
Local _implementation read in WitnetProxy.fallback.
Local _oldImplementation read in WitnetProxy.upgradeTo.
Local _owner read from state inside initialize.
Local _response returned by deleteQuery.

onlyReporters modifier checks _acls().isReporter_[msg.sender] before reporting.

The escrowed reward is transferred to the reporter before the request state fields are zeroed.
The reward is paid to msg.sender, so the caller decides whether the transfer succeeds and can re-enter.
The recipient of the native transfer is msg.sender.
The provided CBOR result bytes are stored into the response record.
The provided drTxHash is validated as non-zero and stored in the response.
The provided timestamp is stored into the response record.

postRequest calls estimateReward to compute the minimum required reward.

The request record is written through the _request storage pointer.

unsetReporters writes false for each address in the reporters ACL mapping.

The proxy fallback delegatecalls the received calldata to the implementation.

upgradeTo delegatecalls isUpgradableFrom and initialize on the implementations.
upgradeTo encodes isUpgradableFrom(msg.sender) and requires it to return true.

The _newImplementation parameter is the target of the initialization delegatecall.
The _initData parameter is forwarded to the initialize delegatecall.
The current implementation is read into the local _oldImplementation for validation.
implementation() reads the implementation address from the EIP-1967 slot.
_getGasPrice returns tx.gasprice which drives the reward requirement.
_getMsgValue returns msg.value which funds the escrowed reward.
_safeTransferTo performs the external native transfer to the reporter.
The incremented query counter is written back to WitnetBoardState.numQueries.
getNextQueryId reads numQueries and returns it plus one.

normalization_plan.reason: _queryId parameter is only used to index the query storage inside _reportResult.
_timestamp parameter is validated and stored in the response inside _reportResult.
_drTxHash parameter is checked non-zero and stored inside _reportResult.
_cborBytes parameter is stored as the response payload inside _reportResult.
_addr parameter is only consumed by postRequest.
_reporters array is only consumed by setReporters.
_newImplementation parameter is only consumed by WitnetProxy.upgradeTo.
_initData parameter is only consumed by WitnetProxy.upgradeTo.
_gasPrice parameter is only consumed by estimateReward.
The local _value is derived from msg.value inside postRequest.
minResultReward local is used in the reward threshold check inside postRequest.
The _request storage pointer local is written inside postRequest.
_newReward local is computed and stored inside upgradeReward.
_owner local is read from storage inside initialize.
